No. I don’t believe the death penalty is ever justified.

Even when the crime is as monstrous as murder or terrorism, I think state killing is too final, too fallible, and too self-justifying to be morally acceptable. The possibility of executing an innocent person is never acceptable, and even when the person is guilty, I think a society gains something better from life without parole: it holds the person accountable without becoming the kind of power that decides it is acceptable to kill in response to killing.

So, in my opinion: no, the death penalty is not justified under any circumstances.
